value.title: Flow reachability: a deterministic stream-owes-a-flow verb
value.summary: Deterministic verb surface for pij workteam: bundled flight-plan flow type + a two-clause flow/plan check verb, red-first, handed off to ermine.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Build the deterministic harness surface pij workteam verbs will call to detect a stream that never produced a flight plan or a valid plan document: bundle flight-plan as a first-class flow type (so harness flow create flight-plan works bare, without the builder skill installed), then add a flow-family check verb that answers two clauses in one envelope — the plan validates (error when absent or invalid) and a flight plan exists and is readable (warning when missing, per Jordan's ruling). Built red-first against fixtures shaped like pij wave streams 098/099 (the real measured failure: 0/9 flight plans, 2/9 no plan document, 9/9 merged green — #140, AI-Substrate/pij#227), and closed with a pij-facing contract plus a handoff and collaboration offer to ermine, whose team wires it into pij workteam.

sections.name: goals
value: pij workteam verbs can detect a stream with no flight plan or an invalid/missing plan document by calling one deterministic harness verb, per-stream, post-hoc, on any worktree
harness flow create flight-plan works bare (no --schema/--template, no builder skill installed) — flight-plan becomes a bundled first-class flow type (fixes the E304 friction, F-15)
missing flight plan reports as a WARNING (degraded, exit 0) by default; missing/invalid plan document reports as an ERROR (exit 1) — Jordans ruled polarity
the verb counts what was examined and excluded, never only what survived
a written pij-facing contract plus a handoff and collaboration offer delivered to ermine (who wires pij using their own workteam)

sections.name: non_goals
value: no wiring into harness checks — ruled out: builder is one SDD flavour among several (OpenSpec etc.)
no nudge mechanism — explicitly deferred until the prompting-in-skills experiment runs
no changes to plan validate / plan ready semantics or envelopes (plan 072 polarity preserved; s080 parity AC) and no edits to acts/plan/index.ts, services/dd/**, acts/dd/**

no pij-repo edits EXCEPT the granted convergence path: DELTA blocks into docs/how/fleet/stand-up.md on branch docs/fleet-live-findings (grant: prime + ermine convergence rule, 2026-08-09 — divergences go back to that file as edits, never a second doc here); all other pij surfaces are propose-and-hand-off only and ~/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/ stays read-only
no enforcement of builder outside workteam context

value.claim: In a repo WITHOUT the builder skill resolvable, `harness flow create flight-plan --slug s --plan-dir <dir> --path <dir>/the-flow.json` (no --schema, no --template) exits 0 and writes a flow the CLI can read back (flow rail succeeds)

A vitest test written BEFORE the verb exists runs the new check verb against the 098-shaped fixture (findings.md + SEAT.md, no plan.dd.json, no the-flow.json) AND the 099-shaped fixture (assets/ only) and was observed RED (verb absent/failing) before implementation; after implementation both fixtures assert envelope status=error, exit 1

The check verb on a folder whose plan.dd.json validates but which has no the-flow.json returns status=degraded (warning), exit 0, with a reason naming the missing flight plan and a next_action carrying the bare flow create invocation
The check verb on a folder with a valid plan.dd.json AND a readable flight plan returns status=ok, exit 0

Every check envelope reports counts of artifacts examined and excluded (plan present/absent, flow present/absent/legacy/malformed/future-version), never only survivors; E301 absent, E308 legacy, E300 malformed and E306 future-version flows each carry a distinct reason and all report as the degraded warning class with exit 0 when the plan itself validates

plan validate and plan ready envelopes are field-equal excluding timestamp, with equal exit codes, against base ee8f37fb behaviour on the probe matrix (E400 no-plan, ok valid, cant-tell no-flow) — and no edits landed in acts/plan/index.ts, services/dd/**, or acts/dd/**
docs/how guide for the bundled flow type + check verb exists; harness checks passes including generated-docs drift

A pij-facing contract document (verb name, invocation, envelope fields, exit codes, warning-vs-error semantics, caching via basis fields where applicable) exists in the plan folder and the handoff + collaboration offer has been sent to ermine via prime, recorded with a pointer

value.title: Bundle flight-plan as a first-class flow type + red fixtures
value.brief: Make harness flow create flight-plan work bare: bake the builder skills flight-plan.schema.json and flight-plan.template.json into the CLI as a bundled type (baked-content pattern), resolve bundled types when --schema/--template are omitted (explicit flags still win), and land the four fixture shapes (098-shaped, 099-shaped, plan-without-flow, both-good) plus a legacy E308 flow. TDD: the bare-create test is observed red before the bundling lands.

value.title: The flow check verb, red-first
value.brief: Add the check verb to the flow act family (acts/flow.ts; one registration line in app.ts if a new act module is cleaner). Working invocation: harness flow check --plan-dir <dir> [--flow <path>] — clause 2 resolves the flight plan at <dir>/the-flow.json by default, --flow overrides (same convention as plan ready). Red-first against the phase-1 fixtures, including the 099-shaped one. Clause 1: plan validity via the plan validate --json envelope of this same binary (CLI-is-the-API; child process, precedent validate-harness-flow). Clause 2: flight-plan existence/readability via readFlowDoc; E301 absent, E308 legacy, E300 malformed and E306 future-version each get a DISTINCT reported reason and ALL compose as the warning class (ruled polarity: only a missing/unusable-plan-document is an error; an unusable flow warns). Verdicts: plan-invalid-or-missing=error(exit 1); plan-ok-but-flow-absent-or-unusable(E301/E308/E300/E306)=degraded warning(exit 0); both-good=ok(0). Envelope counts examined and excluded artifacts; next_action carries the bare create invocation from phase 1.

value.title: Docs, pij-facing contract, ermine handoff
value.brief: Ship the knowledge: docs/how guide for the bundled type + verb; the pij-facing contract in the plan folder (working invocation harness flow check --plan-dir <dir>, envelope fields, exit codes, warning-vs-error semantics, ratifiable verb name); DELTA blocks written into ermines stand-up.md on branch docs/fleet-live-findings in ~/pi-hacking/pij — the ONE granted pij write path (prime+ermine convergence rule; worktrees stay read-only); the handoff + collaboration offer routed via prime; a correcting comment on #140 (the E304 one-liner). harness checks green; just fix; ship via the flow.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Incorporates findings from assets/research-dossier.md (15 findings, 4 historical learnings). Keys: both clauses already have deterministic primitives — plan validate goes E400/exit 1 on the 098/099 shape today, and readFlowDoc (services/flow/flow-service.ts:100-134) distinguishes E301 missing / E300 malformed / E308 legacy / E306 future-version flows. plan ready is 80% of the wanted verb but plan 072 AC-06 deliberately made absent-flow cant-tell, so the new verb diverges by design while plan ready stays untouched. The verb must be CORE: the npm package ships bin/dist/skills only, extension discovery is cwd-only, and flow/plan are reserved extension names. Registration is one act module plus one app.ts line; exit mapping is status-only (ok/degraded 0, error 1, unconfigured 2). No flow validate/check verb exists today. Pre-plan rulings and s080 coordination: assets/design-constraints.md. Dogfood friction with repros: friction-log.md (F1 E304 bare create; F2 dd section asymmetry).

value.rationale: Red-first is a ruled constraint, not a preference: the verb must be observed failing against the known-bad fixtures before it passes — a guard that has only seen good input is demonstrated, not tested. vitest in harness/cli.
value.focus_areas: Verdict composition (error/degraded/ok) across the four fixture shapes; bundled flow-type resolution when --schema/--template are omitted; envelope contract (examined/excluded counts, next_action, exit codes); E308 legacy flow reported distinctly from E301 absent.
value.excluded: Performance/load testing; pij-side integration (ermines to build).
value.mock_usage: None — real on-disk fixtures and real CLI envelopes only.

value.rationale: Detailed guide beside the repos existing harness docs; generated CLI docs cover verb help; the pij-facing contract lives in the plan folder and travels with the handoff.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: Assumes s080 preserves plan validate/ready envelope parity across its phases (their AC; drift is a defect report they want). Assumes the 098/099 shapes reproduced as local fixtures are faithful to the real streams (verified read-only against ~/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/s098-*, s099-*). Assumes acts/flow.ts stays outside s080s frozen set. Risk: self-invoking the CLI for the plan-validate clause adds a child-process hop; precedent exists (validate-harness-flow spawns workers) and koala offered an in-process seam after their phase 2 if shelling proves too slow.

value.question: Final verb name — check is the working name (harness flow check); ratify with ermine during handoff so the pij skill and our docs use one word
Should the verb accept a sweep form (all folders under docs/plans) or stay single-target with pij iterating?
value.note: leaning single-target first; sweep is additive later

value.question: Put plan validate into harness checks?
value.answer: No — ruled out; users may choose other SDD flows (e.g. OpenSpec); enforcement lives in pij workteam verbs+skill, which call harness verbs

value.question: Who builds what?
value.answer: Harness owns the deterministic verbs; pij consumes them (pij will use harness verbs please); s081 delivers verb + red-first proof + contract + handoff/collaboration offer to ermine

value.question: Nudge mechanism in scope?
value.answer: No — leave nudge out for now, no good solution yet; see how prompting in skills goes first

value.question: Bundle flight-plan as a first-class harness flow type?
value.answer: Yes — that is fine, pij can rely on harness

value.question: Missing flight plan: hard failure?
value.answer: No its a warning still — advisory by default, teeth opt-in; plan 072 polarity preserved in plan ready

value.question: Workflow mode / testing / mocks / docs?
value.answer: Full mode; Full TDD; no mocks (real fixtures); docs/how — all four confirmed via Round 1

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: Three phases. Phase 1 bakes the builder flight-plan schema+template into the CLI as a bundled flow type (pattern: existing baked-content modules) and teaches flow create to resolve bundled types when --schema/--template are omitted; it also lands the known-bad fixtures (098-shaped: stray files only; 099-shaped: assets only; plan-without-flow; both-good) with a failing-first test for bare create. Phase 2 adds the check verb to the flow act family (acts/flow.ts, NOT the frozen acts/plan/index.ts), TDD red-first against those fixtures: clause 1 obtains plan validity via the plan validate --json envelope (CLI-is-the-API, s080 seam), clause 2 reads the flight plan via readFlowDoc; verdicts compose as plan-invalid=error(1), flow-missing-or-legacy=degraded(0) warning, both-good=ok(0); the envelope counts examined and excluded artifacts and its next_action carries the bare create invocation. Phase 3 writes the docs/how guide and the pij-facing contract, converges DELTA blocks into ermines stand-up.md branch, sends the handoff + collaboration offer via prime, and corrects the E304 one-liner on #140.

value.finding: plan validate already fails E400/exit 1 on the exact 098/099 shape — clause 1 exists; the gap is composition and the flow clause (dossier F-01/F-02)
value.action: Phase 2 composes rather than reinvents: shell plan validate --json for clause 1, readFlowDoc for clause 2

value.finding: Plan 072 AC-06 deliberately made absent-flow cant-tell in plan ready, and s080 freezes acts/plan/index.ts — the new polarity cannot land inside plan ready (dossier H-01)
value.action: New verb in the flow act family; plan ready untouched; divergence documented in the contract

value.finding: The npm package ships no extensions and extension discovery is cwd-only — a pij-callable verb must be core (dossier F-10/F-11/F-12)
value.action: New subverb registered in acts/flow.ts; fence tell-first for harness/cli/src already flagged to prime (spine 54204)

value.finding: flight-plan is not a bundled flow type — the one-liner #140 proposes for stream briefs fails E304 (friction F1)
value.action: Phase 1 bakes schema+template into the CLI; Jordan ruled pij can rely on harness

value.finding: E308 legacy flows read as errors distinct from absent flows — a hand-written the-flow.json must not count as a flow that exists
value.action: Fixture + test for the legacy shape; envelope reports it distinctly

value.risk: s080 lands a plan-validate behaviour change mid-build and the shelled envelope drifts
value.mitigation: Parity is s080s own AC; AC-06 pins the probe matrix at base behaviour; drift becomes a defect report koala has asked for

value.risk: Self-shelling the CLI for clause 1 is slow or fragile in pij call sites
value.mitigation: Precedent exists (validate-harness-flow spawns workers); koala offered an in-process seam after their phase 2 if measured slow

value.mitigation: Fixture shapes copied from the real worktrees read-only and documented in-fixture; the real streams remain the validation reference

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Never edit acts/plan/index.ts, services/dd/**, or acts/dd/** (s080 frozen surfaces); any plan-family surface change routes through koala or prime first
Always invoke THIS worktrees CLI (node harness/cli/bin/harness.js) — bare harness resolves to the root checkouts dist; rebuild with just build after src edits
Explicit pathspecs only, never git add -A; just fix before pushing; tell prime before push/PR
Red-first discipline: each fixtures failing test is committed/observed BEFORE the code that turns it green; label claims MEASURED or REASONED in reports
Real streams under ~/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/ are READ-ONLY references — never write there; local fixtures live in harness/cli test fixtures
